ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Part of the forest ecosystem is shown. What will happen to the moose population if the branches are cut down and are on fire?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a forest ecosystem food web. On the right there is a moose labeled Moose, with a “primary consumer” label next to it. There is a food relationship between the moose and the tree branches below labeled “branches,” and the branches are labeled “producer.” Reasoning: The question says the branches are cut down and catch fire, which means the moose’s food source is destroyed or reduced. When a consumer’s food decreases, the energy and resources it can obtain become less, so its population size will decrease. Conclusion: The moose population will decrease.
